user.title: Set up NWS Weather Signal
user.description: Choose how alerts are located and how many alert slots to create.

point.title: Coordinates
point.description: Enter the point that should receive active alerts.

zone.title: NWS zone or county
zone.description: Enter a six-character forecast zone or county code, such as INZ009 or INC033.

area.title: State or marine area
area.description: Enter a two-letter state or marine area code.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to retrieve alerts from weather.gov.

abort.already_configured: This alert location is already configured.

init.title: NWS Weather Signal options
init.description: Changing the number of slots reloads the integration.
